path.where: Night Harbor newbie yards / Underdocks newbie yard
path.why: Do the starter quest. Rats, beetles and skeletons are easy practice for drains.
The best early group dungeon. Skeletons come in groups — good practice holding several at once.
Easy solo trash outside the gates for Deep Elves.

path.where: Underdocks Deepcut Bandit Camp & Wererat Warrens
path.why: Steady melee camps for Underdocks starts.
Easy solo pulls near the entrance; spider swarms deeper in for group tanking.
Ashira and smugglers camps with low-level named mobs. Better with a group.

path.where: Tel Ekir Ashira Outskirts / Tomb deeper halls
path.why: Tel Ekir drops the Overlord's Plate Helm and Shield of the Protector . High Marshal Fionna (~16) waits at the bottom of the Tomb.
Dense camps where a self-healing tank shines.
